svg.title: Visitor tracking in a red zone
svg.desc: A receiver forwards a registered visitor's badge detection through the Raspberry Pi to the backend. The backend saves a red-zone observation, notifies the staff dashboard, and supplies the latest map observation. Analytics reviews saved observations later.

g.text: Visitor tracking in a red zone
A visitor's badge is registered to an active visit and detected near a staff-only corridor.
Later, review saved observations for unusual movement
Match the badge to a visit at capture time.
Look up the receiver's zone and check access.
Save the red observation and security event.
